info.title: ediFabric Cloud API
info.description:
REST API that translates EDI files to JSON and back, validates them, and generates acknowledgments. v2 supports X12, HIPAA, EDIFACT, EANCOM, HL7, NCPDP and VDA. For X12 and HIPAA, v3 does the same with two operations, Parse and Build: see the v3 document.

**Authentication.** Send your serial key in the `Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key` header. To try the API without an account, use the demo serial key `bd96a836feca45cb91c86ee65d281f52`. It has a small daily quota. When it runs out, [sign up free for Community](https://www.edifabric.com/pricing.html) and use your own serial key.

**Quota.** Each read, write, validate or acknowledge call is one operation. When the plan's quota is used up, the API returns 403.

**Models.** The JSON property names come from the transaction's model. See the [EDI spec library](https://www.edifabric.com/specs/index.html) for each model and its OpenEDI template.

parameters.name: basicSyntax
parameters.description: All data elements with alpha (A) or alphanumeric (AN) data types are validated against a syntax set of allowed characters. The default syntax set is the Extended, hence the default for this parameter is false. By setting this to true, validation will use the Basic syntax set.

parameters.name: syntaxSet
parameters.description: In case you need to validate against a syntax set, different than Basic and Extended, populate this field with all of the allowed symbols, url-escaped.

parameters.name: skipTrailer
parameters.description: You are allowed to validate an X12Interchange with missing interchange, functional group or transaction trailers (IEA, GE, SE). This is because these will be automatically applied during the Write oprtaion so you don't have to worry about counting the items. By default it is expected that all trailers are present when you validate the X12Interchange and by default, this is set to false. To skip all trailer validation, set this to true.

parameters.name: structureOnly
parameters.description: This is equivalent to HIPAA Snip level 1, where only the structure and control segments are validated. By default, this is set to false, however if you want to not validate things such as data types, number of repeteitions or dates, set this to true.

parameters.name: syntaxSet
parameters.description: In case you need to validate against a syntax set, different than Basic and Extended, populate this field with all of the allowed symbols, url-escaped.

parameters.name: detectDuplicates
parameters.description: If you need to detect duplicates as in functional groups or transactions with the same reference number, set this flag to true. The default is false.

parameters.name: tranRefNumber
parameters.description: The default is 1. Set this to whatever the 997 or 999 X12Interchange.ST.TransactionSetControlNumber_02 needs to be. In case there are multiple acknowledgments (for multiple functional groups), this will be starting reference number and every subsequent acknowledgment will have the previous reference number incremented with 1.

parameters.name: interchangeRefNumber
parameters.description: The default is 1. Set this to whatever the 997 or 999 X12Interchange.ISA.InterchangeControlNumber_13 needs to be.

parameters.name: ackForValidTrans
parameters.description: The default is false. Set this to true if you need AK2 loops included for all valid transaction as well. By default AK2 loops are generated only for invalid transactions.

parameters.name: batchAcks
parameters.description: The default is true. Set this to false if you need to generate separate X12Interchange for each acknowledgment. By default all acknowledgments are batched in the same X12Interchange.

parameters.name: technicalAck
parameters.description: The default technical acknowledgment TA1 is generated according to X12Interchange.ISA.AcknowledgementRequested_14. You can either enforce it to always generate TA1s or suppress it to never generate any TA1s. This will override the flag in X12Interchange.ISA.AcknowledgementRequested_14. The available values are: default, enforce, suppress.

parameters.name: ack
parameters.description: The default value is 997. The type of acknowledgment being generated. Set this to 999 if you need to generate an implementation instead of functional acknowledgment. The available values are: 997, 999.

parameters.name: ak901isP
parameters.description: The value of the AK9's first element. By default it is "E". Set this to true if you want this value to be "P" instead.

parameters.name: syntaxSet
parameters.description: In case you need to validate against a syntax set, different than UNOA and UNOB, populate this field with all of the allowed symbols, url-escaped. All data elements with alpha (A) or alphanumeric (AN) data types are validated against a syntax set of allowed characters. The supported syntax sets are UNOA and UNOB. The validator infers the correct syntax set from EdifactInterchange.UNB.SYNTAXIDENTIFIER_1.SyntaxIdentifier_1. The symbols added to this field will override the corresponding sets in both UNOA and UNOB.

parameters.name: skipTrailer
parameters.description: You are allowed to validate an EdifactInterchange with missing interchange, functional group or transaction trailers (UNZ, UNE, UNT). This is because these will be automatically applied during the Write oprtaion so you don't have to worry about counting the items. By default it is expected that all trailers are present when you validate the EdifactInterchange and by default, this is set to false. To skip all trailer validation, set this to true.

parameters.description: This is equivalent to HIPAA Snip level 1, where only the structure and control segments are validated. By default, this is set to false, however if you want to not validate things such as data types, number of repeteitions or dates, set this to true.

ApiKey.name: Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key
ApiKey.description: Your serial key. The demo serial key `bd96a836feca45cb91c86ee65d281f52` works without an account and has a small daily quota.

ErrorDetails.description: The error body. `Code` is the HTTP status code and `Details` has the reasons.

Id.description: The transaction identifier, for example 837P or INVOIC.

Model.description: The transaction's class in the model, for example EdiNation.X12.HIPAA005010.TS837P.

BadRequest.description: The request is invalid. `Details` has the reason.

Unauthorized.description: The `Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key` header is missing or the key is invalid.

Forbidden.description: The plan's operation quota is used up. On Community, that is the shared daily quota.

ServerError.description: The operation failed, or something went wrong on our end. `Details` has the reason.
